name: gizza-ai/nmap-output-parser
summary: Parse nmap XML or greppable output into host/port tables

tool.description: Parse nmap scan output into a clean sortable table of hosts, hostnames, ports, protocols, states, services and detected versions. Paste XML from `nmap -oX` or greppable output from `nmap -oG`; format can auto-detect, xml, or greppable. output can be markdown, csv or json. sort_by can be host, port or service. open_only defaults true so closed/filtered ports are hidden unless explicitly requested. Runs locally.

format.description: Input format: auto-detect (default), xml for nmap `-oX`, or greppable for nmap `-oG`.

input.description: Raw nmap output to parse: XML from `nmap -oX` or greppable text from `nmap -oG`.

open_only.description: Only include open/open|filtered ports. Turn off to include closed or filtered ports too.

output.description: Output format for the parsed port table: markdown (default), csv, or json.

sort_by.description: Sort rows by host (default; IPv4 numerically), port, or service.
